entities.name: F. Holland Day
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fred Holland Day was an American photographer and publisher. He was prominent in literary and photography circles in the late nineteenth century and was a leading Pictorialist. He was an early and vocal advocate for accepting photography as a fine art.
